baseCohortDefinition.name: Patients with HTS encounters during period

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = '264daIZd-f80e-48fe-nba9-P37f2W1905Pv') AND e.encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = '264daIZd-f80e-48fe-nba9-P37f2W1905Pv') AND e.encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0

SELECT DATE(e.encounter_datetime) FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = '264daIZd-f80e-48fe-nba9-P37f2W1905Pv') AND e.encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0 ORDER BY e.encounter_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, e.encounter_datetime) FROM encounter e INNER JOIN person p ON e.patient_id = p.person_id WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = '264daIZd-f80e-48fe-nba9-P37f2W1905Pv') AND e.encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0 ORDER BY e.encounter_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN pa.value_text IS NOT NULL THEN pa.value_text WHEN pa.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('90005', '5555')) THEN 'SINGLE' WHEN pa.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '90006') THEN 'MARRIED' WHEN pa.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('90007', '1056')) THEN 'DIVORCED/SEPARATED' WHEN pa.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '90009') THEN 'WIDOWED' WHEN pa.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '90280') THEN 'CHILD' WHEN pa.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('1057', '1060')) THEN 'NEVER MARRIED/LIVING WITH PARTNER' ELSE '' END FROM person_attribute pa WHERE pa.person_id = :patientId AND pa.person_attribute_type_id = (SELECT person_attribute_type_id FROM person_attribute_type WHERE uuid = '8d871f2a-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f') AND pa.voided = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN o.value_coded IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM obs o INNER JOIN encounter e ON o.encounter_id = e.encounter_id WHERE o.concept_id = 99493 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 AND e.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 99493 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN o.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '90003') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 162982 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN o1.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '90003') OR o2.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '90003') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM obs o1 INNER JOIN encounter e1 ON o1.encounter_id = e1.encounter_id LEFT JOIN obs o2 ON o2.person_id = :patientId AND o2.concept_id = 165183 AND o2.voided = 0 WHERE o1.concept_id = 99494 AND o1.person_id = :patientId AND o1.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o1.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o1.voided = 0 AND e1.voided = 0 ORDER BY o1.obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1
